items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Mostly Spartan like that, when you get together.

ctx.x: Sometime I heard a big band on the radio, oh, been a good while back. Not from here though, I know they're not from here. There's some nice, nice music.
I wondered when you were with Celestan. Do you remember what band you were with before you went with Celestan? Or were you Spartan or what?
Mostly Spartan like that, when you get together.
